ai_content.desc_en: Trapped in a Dating Sim: The World of Otome Games Is Tough for Mobs. An office worker reincarnates as Leon in a harsh dating sim, where women rule and only handsome men have a chance. Leon's secret weapon? He remembers his past life, including a complete playthrough of the game. Watch as Leon sparks a revolution to change this world and fulfill his desire for a quiet rural life.
